status: Revision for review: print one splice U and one splice plate, both solid. Unprinted; geometry checks only.
request: Make the splice a touch longer, and give the plate a tongue that presses down into the U channel, so the screws can compress the tube and hold it tighter.

parent.checkpoint: US-TUBE-SPLICE-R002 (removed from the tree; in git history at commit 4fc0c3f)
parent.profile: Clamp U cross-section of US-NECK-MOUNT-R010 (designs/ultraskelly/src/enclosure.json, commit c49c6a1)
parent.fit_test: U1 (18.9 mm pocket), chosen by the user on the tube on 2026-11-03

changes_from_parent: Length 60 -> 70 mm (grip 30 -> 35 mm per tube piece)
Plate tongue added along the full length: 3 mm tall, 18.3 mm wide, 0.3 mm each side between the arms
Arms 17 -> 20 mm above the pocket floor, so they stand past the tube; the nut slots rise with them, so M2.5 x 16 still fits
Plate prints tongue up with its head recesses on the bed, in place of its tube face on the bed
Base 8 mm, plate 8 mm, corner screws 6 mm from the ends and width 38.8 mm kept

parameters.splice.json: grip 35 per tube piece, base 8, plate 8, tongue 3 with 0.3 each side, 3.3 under each head, holes end 2 below the pocket, row inset 6, screw 16

splice-u.stl.part: Splice U: U1 pocket (18.9 mm), 8 mm base, 20 mm arms, 70 mm long, four M2.5 captured-nut slots
splice-u.stl.orientation: On its back, pocket open upward; as exported.

splice-plate.stl.part: Splice plate, 8 mm thick with a 3 mm by 18.3 mm tongue, M2.5 hole and head recess at each corner
splice-plate.stl.orientation: Flat, tongue up, head recesses on the bed; as exported.

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

hardware.use: Plate to U, one at each corner, into the captured nuts
hardware.check: validate() fits M2.5 screws from 13.9 to 24.8 mm across 18.0 to 18.6 mm tubes

hardware.item: M2.5 hex nut, 5.0 mm across flats, 2.0 mm thick (plain, not nylon-insert)
hardware.use: In the U side slots (5.4 by 2.6 mm)

buy.screws: M2.5 socket-head cap screws, 16 mm (at least 4)
buy.nuts: M2.5 hex nuts, 5.0 mm across flats (at least 4)

interfaces.tube: Square tube of 18.0 to 18.6 mm: 18.9 mm pocket, 0.3 to 0.9 mm of sideways play; the plate tongue presses both pieces against the base
interfaces.joint: Tube ends butt at z = 35, halfway along the U; the plate and its tongue span the joint
interfaces.matched_parts: The plate holes and tongue match this U only; print both from this checkpoint.

design_guidance.rule: FDM parts are weaker between layers; orient structural parts for their load.
design_guidance.change: U prints on its back and the plate flat, so bending at the joint runs along their layers; the screw clamping crosses the U layers (untested).

design_guidance.rule: Strength comes mostly from perimeters; most parts need 10 to 15 % infill, rarely over 30 %. A PETG hook held 110 kg at 100 % infill and 54 kg at 30 % with 3 perimeters.
design_guidance.change: 6 perimeters and 100 % infill, because the joint flexes.

design_guidance.rule: Walls thinner than one perimeter (about 0.45 mm) do not print.
design_guidance.change: At least three perimeters (1.35 mm) around every screw feature; see geometry_validation.walls_mm.

design_guidance.rule: Moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance; vertical holes print undersized.
design_guidance.change: Tongue 0.3 mm from each arm; 2.9 mm clearance holes, all vertical as printed; U1 pocket 18.9 mm with 0.15 to 0.45 mm per side.

design_guidance.rule: Chamfers rather than fillets facing the bed; edges on the bed flare where fit matters.
design_guidance.change: Rounded corners only on edges vertical as printed; bed edges square; no fit surface touches the bed (the head recesses that open on the bed are loose on the heads).

design_guidance.rule: Overhangs up to 45 degrees print without supports; bridges sag unless shorter than 5 mm.
design_guidance.change: Downward faces: the four U nut-slot ceilings (5.4 mm bridges, 0.6 mm of slot over the nut) and the four plate head-recess ceilings (5.1 mm bridges, where the heads seat).

splice grip length (35 mm per piece, 5 mm more than R002 as requested: rock limit 0.49 to 1.47 degrees)
tongue height (3 mm; the arms rise the same, keeping the clamp's 1 mm minimum plate-to-arm gap)

robot_clearance: Not assessed. Only the splice size and the bare tube per piece are given.

tube fit of a U printed on its back (the fit-tested U1 printed standing)

screw clamping across the U layers
